_comment: Source of truth for review-needed labels (R-209, R-609, R-506, R-701). Read by .github/scripts/pr-process.mjs, which labeler.yml and review-gate.yml both run. Globs: ** crosses directories, * stays inside one. A PR gets a label when any changed path matches any glob. One combined review (qa-engineer) for every PR; Security review only for workflow and header changes (ADR-0026).
